messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — USW1 shelf-18 showing repeated thermal + egress spikes since 03:10. Noticed a single tenant blasting long context batches and prefetching KV; other slices reporting tail latencies rising ~2-3x.

Ajay Patel: seeing same in telemetry. heatmap shows a 12-minute correlation between the tenant's sustained HBM usage and NIC Q3 saturation.

Sasha Rivera: which tenant? any customer id?

Maya Chen: tenant: tid-8792 (internal sandbox account). infra-bot alerted at 03:12 with egress QPS jump + slab churn.

InfraBot: ALERT shelf-18: GPU temp 82C, egress TX 950MB/s, kvcache_evictions +420% over baseline. Incident ticket created: #INC-8421.

Liam O'Connor: if it's prefetching, warm-pool behavior might amplify KV churn. Are they pinned to a hot slot or stealing burst credits?

Ajay Patel: quick snapshot from allocator: "alloc_profile": "fractional-dedicated", "burst_credit": -120, "kv_warm_hits": 0.2.

Maya Chen: short-term fix proposal: soft-fence tenant into a dedicated noisy-pool with ratecap on egress and batch size clamp. That buys other tenants breathing room without full hard isolation cost.

Sasha Rivera: agree. Can we apply an egress policer rule and a prefetch throttle flag? configwise we have 2 knobs: rate_cap_kbps and kv_prefetch_window.

Ajay Patel: run this (quick):
```
allocctl set-policy --tenant=tid-8792 --pool=noisy-shelf-pool --rate_kbps=600000 --prefetch_window=256
```
That should drop their egress to ~600MB/s and limit prefetch to smaller windows.

Liam O'Connor: cost daydream: soft-fencing still leaves them on the same host family. If spike continues we fallback to fractional dedicated carve (higher $) or migration. Do we want automatic fallback after N alerts?

Maya Chen: yes — suggestion: if slab_eviction_rate > 300% for 10m after soft-fence, then escalate to carveout and live-migrate. Add an automation ticket.

InfraBot: ACTION scheduled: apply soft-fence now -> running policy change.

(30s) InfraBot: policy change applied. Rate cap and prefetch window set. Monitoring stream: https://telemetry.redwood/shelf-18/streams/INC-8421

Ajay Patel: initial telemetry: egress down 55%, tail latency improving. KV evictions trending down but still above baseline.

Sasha Rivera: good. Request ops to keep an eye for thermal lingering; warm pools can take 10-15m to settle.

Maya Chen: I'm creating a short runbook step to handle recurring tid-8792 behavior and to convert to permanent dedicated slice if they want sustained throughput.

Liam O'Connor: one more note — marking this tenant for cost-review. Prefetch-heavy workloads need guidance (we should update docs with recommended batch sizes + caching patterns).

Maya Chen: agreed. Quick doc snippet to add to customer guide: "avoid wide prefetch windows on shared shelves; prefer KV hinting + small batch sizes; request dedicated capacity for >500MB/s sustained egress."

Ajay Patel: will patch alert thresholds too — tie the thermal+egress composite so infra-bot suggests soft-fence automatically next time.

Sasha Rivera: SGTM. Please ping me if we need migration windows into off-peak.

Maya Chen: thanks team. Closing this thread once TELEMETRY shows 30m stable. :thumbsup:
